correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact objects and all quantifiers. Unit pair-eligibility gives signed shortfall B=d-2a and goods Prop1 iff B<=2. Under greater-deficit-first allocation, any newly positive deficit r must combine two distinct prior components each with size >=2^(r-1) (r=1 base), giving 2^r component vertices. A forest with s edges has component size <=s+1. Binary adversary recursively joins marked r-1 deficient endpoints on disjoint trees of size 2^(r-1), always forcing the new loser to exactly r. This uses 2^r-1 edges, with forest-preserving padding for longer horizons. Therefore exact prefix minimax floor(log2(t+1)); at n<=7 no violation, whereas n=8,t=7 forces B=3. Exact dynamic minimax computations for all horizons on n=2..6 and explicit level-one-through-four constructions replay successfully from packaged checker.py. Finite enumeration does not substitute for the all-order inductive proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Arbitrary-eligibility O(log n)-approximate Prop1 does not imply exact Prop1 on forests. Offline Prop1 existence cannot ensure irrevocable every-prefix maintenance. A constant discrepancy orientation with path flips changes assignments and hence is inapplicable to the no-reassignment guarantee.

originality.rationale: The accepted result is the combined all-horizon exact signed-deficit minimax and sharp forest-restricted eligibility-aware Prop1 frontier. Bender et al. already establish the related logarithmic no-recourse forest outdegree upper bound; we do not claim that weaker upper fact as new. Their outdegree tradeoff does not establish a matching signed-deficit lower bound or forest prefix Prop1 cutoff. Biburger et al. prove general approximate goods Prop1 and unrestricted negative behavior, not the forest equality. Gupta et al. permit recourse; Sun et al. are offline. Searches of public mathematical records and accessible prior same-area claims returned no statement implying the full theorem. Remaining folklore/completeness risks are explicit.
residual_risks: A simple binary-component merging adversary may be implicit in older load-balancing or union-by-rank folklore not reached by searched texts; public search non-coverage is not a uniqueness proof.
One related 2026 offline orientation source was compared through its original abstract and citations, rather than all full-text pages.
No independent scientific or publication-priority validation.

value.rationale: Acyclic pairwise eligibility is a mathematically natural restriction of a 2026 online fair-division model. Determining exactly when irrevocable goods assignments can maintain eligibility-aware Prop1 is operationally relevant. The all-order precise prefix minimax formula and sharp seven-agent feasible/eight-agent seven-good obstruction expose a structural boundary invisible in unrestricted multigraph theory; not merely a named finite example or a routine numerical census.
